messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — upstream disclosed CVE-2026-1458 (FlashAttention fused-kernel OOB) and protobuf CVE-2026-0789. Automated scan flagged our vLLM/Triton images. Need fast triage: impact across hosted / dedicated / private and any KMS/RBAC audit implications.
Priya Patel: Ill pull inventory of images and customer pinning. Short answer: hosted images we control, Dedicated uses our reserved images (easier), Private customers may have pinned hashes.
sec-bot: automated-scan: HIGH - CVE-2026-1458 affects flash-attn <=1.2.3 when run with fused-kernel enabled on CUDA >=11.8. protobuf CVE-2026-0789 is a deserialization edge-case in proto-lite <3.21.
Marco Ruiz: Confirmed we bundle flash-attn v1.2.2 in the vllm runtime container. Triton plugin 0.9.4 also links fused kernels. I can reproduce the OOB in a stress harness.
Elena Ivanova: For Private: any kernel/userland rebuild touches signing & KMS. We must plan KMS unwrap/rotate and emit audit entries for image signing. Also check customer policy for auto-updates.
Josh Meyer: Oncall mitigations: enable strict sandbox mode for model execution (drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN), turn on extra runtime audit logging, and quarantine any images built with flagged libs. I can enable flags now for hosted.
Alex Chen: Proposed priority & schedule: 1) Hosted: hotpatch container images -> canary to 5% tomorrow AM, roll to 100% after perf/regressions. 2) Dedicated: schedule maintenance window next Tue 03:00-07:00 UTC for image swap + quick smoke tests. 3) Private: notify customers with guidance + provide a signed backported image and steps. Agree?
Priya Patel: Timeline: packaging patches and new images by EOD today, canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Need approval for kernel rebuild on Dedicated (non-disruptive attempt). Also coordinating with infra to reserve nodes.
Marco Ruiz: Testing plan: run regression suite + perf bench (latency P50/P95) and the fuzzing harness against new flash-attn + proto bump. Note: protobuf bump breaks sentencepiece wheel on py3.8 in one test — adding compatibility check.
Elena Ivanova: RBAC/KMS changes: create a temporary role `infra:runtime-patcher` scoped to image-build and kms:unwrap. All actions logged to audit-store. Add short policy snippet for records.
Elena Ivanova: ```json
{
  "policy": "allow",
  "role": "infra:runtime-patcher",
  "resources": ["images:build","kms:unwrap","audit:write"]
}
```
Josh Meyer: Incident response notes: if we detect exploit telemetry, page SRE + Sec, rotate affected KMS keys and revoke image signatures, run forensic container snapshots, and trigger customer notifications. Postmortem lead: Marco.
Alex Chen: Assignments: Priya = packaging & release artifacts, Marco = test + perf + postmortem lead, Elena = KMS key rotation plan + RBAC & audit pr, Josh = oncall mitigations & runbook updates. Ill draft the customer advisory and a short internal timeline.
Priya Patel: I'll also open backport PRs for the protobuf patch and add the sentencepiece compatibility test.
sec-bot: ticket INF-4523 created (triage + rollout plan). Scheduled re-scan in 4 hours. :eyes: :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Sync 09:30 UTC standup in #eng-security to confirm canary results and publish advisory. Thanks everyone.
